cost: O(n) sieve time and storage. Independent trial factorization through10000 has O(N sqrt N) upper bound. Allocation failure follows Vec policy.
description: Return inclusive mu table with mu(0)=0,mu(1)=1. Positive square-divisible k maps0; otherwise (-1)^r for r distinct prime factors. Linear sieve assigns each composite by least prime: p divides i => mu(ip)=0 and stop; else mu(ip)=-mu(i). Reject n>1000000 before allocation. Reference: Hardy and Wright, An Introduction to the Theory of Numbers, chapter XVI, arithmetical functions.
